name: Regenerations Restored
oracle_text:
Vanishing 12 (This enchantment enters with twelve time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.)
Whenever one or more time counters are removed from this enchantment, scry 1 and you gain 1 life. Then if this enchantment has no time counters on it, exile it. When you do, take an extra turn after this one.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more time counters are removed from this enchantment, scry 1 and you gain 1 life. Then if this enchantment has no time counters on it, exile it. When you do, take an extra turn after this one.

needs.what: a "whenever one or more <kind> counters are removed from this permanent" trigger that fires once per removal (one primitives.remove_counters call), not once per counter: `batched: true` accepted on the `counter_removed` event, queuing one firing per COUNTER_REMOVED event with the event's whole `amount`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `counter_removed` deliberately splits a removal of N counters into N firings (triggers._per_counter_events, 603.2c for "a counter"), so removing several time counters at once would scry and gain life several times; `counter_removed` is not in triggers.BATCHED_EVENTS, so the loader refuses `batched` on it; `last_counter_removed` hears only the removal that leaves none and would miss every other tick
